title: SOHCAHTOA
text: Tangent of $$\theta$$ is the ratio of opposite over adjacent for a right triangle with angle $$\theta$$

title: Construct a right triangle
text: Construct a right triangle with angle $$\theta$$ so that $$\tan(\theta)=3x.$$ \n We assume a triangle with opposite side $$3x$$ and adjacent side $$1$$.\n##figure1.gif##

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Diagram of a right reference triangle. An acute angle is labeled theta. The leg opposite angle theta is labeled three x, and the leg adjacent to angle theta is labeled one. The hypotenuse is unlabeled.

title: The hypotenuse
text: Compute the hypotenuse from Pythagorean theorem.

figureAlts.figure2.gif: Diagram of a right reference triangle. An acute angle is labeled theta. The leg opposite angle theta is labeled three x, and the leg adjacent to angle theta is labeled one. The hypotenuse is labeled as the square root of the quantity nine x squared plus one.

title: SOHCAHTOA
text: Cosine is adjacent over hypotenuse. Combine those two algebraic pieces.\n##figure3.gif##

figureAlts.figure3.gif: Diagram of a right reference triangle. An acute angle is labeled theta. The leg opposite angle theta is labeled three x, and the leg adjacent to angle theta is labeled one. The hypotenuse is labeled as the square root of the quantity nine x squared plus one.
